description: This file defines safe numeric conversion utilities, including range checking, casting, saturation, and range enforcement for numeric types. It provides templates and classes for compile-time and runtime safety in numeric conversions, as well as performance optimizations for specific conversions.

classes.name: StrictNumeric
classes.description: A template class that enforces compile-time range checking for numeric types, used for safe API boundaries and to prevent implicit truncation or overflow.

methods.name: checked_cast
methods.description: Performs a checked cast between numeric types, ensuring no overflow or underflow occurs.

methods.name: saturated_cast
methods.description: Performs a cast that saturates at numeric limits instead of overflowing.

methods.name: strict_cast
methods.description: Performs a static cast with compile-time range validation, causing a compile error if the cast is unsafe.

methods.name: MakeStrictNum
methods.description: Creates a StrictNumeric object from a given arithmetic value.
